//generatorPackage: The babelfhir-ts generator, as published on GitHub Packages. Read by scripts/list-igs.js and the publish workflow; .npmrc maps its scope.
//igTools: The shared resolver (@max-health-inc/ig-tools) picks the newest generator release that passed stable parity, is published and is not deprecated. Run via npx by the publish workflow and scripts/list-igs.js.
//minSupportedGenerator: Oldest generator release this publisher can use: parity-matrix.json, which scripts/list-igs.js reads, first shipped in 1.5.18.
//minParityValidation: Optional absolute floor (percent) on the LOWEST per-validator `validation` score in babelfhir-ts's stable parity history. null disables it. Presence of a parity entry is already required, which catches hard failures; this only guards soft regressions. Kept off by default because a healthy release currently scores internal 72 / firely 84 / hl7 82 — a plausible-looking floor of 80 would reject it. Set deliberately once the normal band is known.
